name: Grand Arena
description: A dimension where combat is everything — honor, currency, identity. Once a world of noble competition where Boxer Nike was undefeated champion. Now fights are brutal and meaningless, the arena's glory hollowed out by corruption.

atmosphere.visual: Boxing rings, neon fight cards, underground pits, roaring crowds
atmosphere.danger: Corrupted fighters, rigged matches, fight-to-the-death pits

charles.name: Gladiator Charles
charles.title: The Cornerman
charles.description: Trains fighters not just to win, but to fight with meaning. Has watched the Arena descend from honor to brutality.
charles.wisdom: True strength is knowing when not to fight
charles.backstory: Once the greatest trainer in the Arena. Now operates underground, preparing those who still believe combat can be noble.

legendaryNike.name: Nike Tyson Nike
legendaryNike.title: The Knockout King
legendaryNike.description: Undefeated champion whose name evolved from Boxer Nike to Nike Tyson over millennia as legend became myth. His Fiery Fists of Furociousness are legendary. In Comic Book 1, he sacrificed himself fighting Nolem directly.
legendaryNike.corruptionReason: Boredom — no worthy opponents left. The loneliness of greatness.
legendaryNike.freedBy: Proving that a worthy opponent isn't someone who can match your fists — it's someone worth fighting FOR

harbinger.name: Slate
harbinger.title: The Burned-Out Collector
harbinger.emotionalTheme: Trauma disguised as apathy — lost six partners
harbinger.corruptionReason: After losing six partners to corruption, severed all bonds rather than risk more pain. Didn't join Nolem — just stopped caring.
harbinger.description: Most sympathetic Harbinger. Not evil, just exhausted. Fights out of habit. First Harbinger redeemed in the game — watches the Walker's bonds in action and chooses to reconnect.

act2Legendaries.name: Berjador Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Paces endlessly with white-hot scales, fighting shadows for centuries. His Infinite Charge builds with every blow.

act2Legendaries.name: Peter Porker Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Exhausted spider-sense hero in ancient webs. Attacks from desperate need to prove he can still protect something.

locations.name: The Ring
locations.description: The main fighting arena where challengers are tested

locations.name: The Underground
locations.description: Where Gladiator Charles trains fighters in secret

locations.name: The Dragon's Pit
locations.description: Berjador Nike's burning domain beneath the Arena

locations.name: The Rafters
locations.description: Where Peter Porker Nike watches from ancient webs

locations.name: The Title Ring
locations.description: Where Nike Tyson waits for a worthy challenger

dimensionalAnchor.name: Champion's Wraps
dimensionalAnchor.description: Hand wraps that glow with the fire of every honest fight ever fought in the Arena
dimensionalAnchor.obtainedFrom: Nike Tyson Nike after freeing him

primeEraConnection.role: Boxer Nike's home dimension. One of the five Champion recruitment sites.
